engine: JSDOM; real UI modules; synthetic RPC and email transport
tests: Only active vacant adult positions offer invitations
Position entry preselects the saved position and scope without granting access
Creation uses the selected position revision and explicitly reviewed permissions
Back and Cancel return to positions without creating another invitation
Edit screen protects unsaved edits and invites only to the saved position
A position filled or removed before opening is rejected without a fallback role
Retry after a loading failure retains the intended position
Late invitation responses cannot overwrite a different tab
Read-only members have no position invitation action
Ordinary membership remains separate and all transport stays synthetic
